integrity: The analytic root-recursion proof and exact harmonic formula are supplied; finite exhaustive enumeration and recurrence checks are supporting evidence and not a proof for arbitrary n.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent random permutations of distinct keys; path length sums root-to-node edge depths. First-order sensitivity only at unit record bias; no all-parameter monotonicity, joint limit law, or independent priority certification. Published multivariate methods may imply the formula implicitly; full 2024 record-bias preprint not conclusively examined.
title: Exact negative covariance of right-spine length and total path length in random binary search trees
